messages.content: Before the hotel cancellation window closes, compare the three Phoenix options on the full three-night cost, parking, drive times, and the terms for Wednesday night. I also need Thursday airport timing included.

For April 6-9, the site-adjacent option is $612.84 including tax plus $36 parking, or $648.84 total. It is about 8 minutes from the audit site, but Wednesday night becomes nonrefundable once booked. Thursday’s drive to PHX is approximately 28-35 minutes at that hour. The Holiday Inn & Suites Goodyear is $571.26 including tax with parking included. Allow 14-18 minutes to the site and 25-32 minutes to PHX Thursday morning; cancellation is free until 6:00 p.m. local time on April 5, including all three nights. The airport hotel is $519.09 including tax with free parking, but audit-day drives are estimated at 35-50 minutes each way. It is about 7 minutes from the terminal Thursday.
Does the Holiday Inn total match what is already held, or would changing the rate add anything?

It matches the existing reservation: $571.26 for three nights, tax included, with no parking charge. No rate change or additional deposit is required. The reservation remains cancellable in full until 6:00 p.m. Arizona time on Sunday, April 5; after that, the stated penalty is one night including tax.
And for the 9:05 Thursday flight, what departure time from the hotel is sensible with the rental return?

Leaving at 6:15 a.m. provides about 30 minutes for the drive, 15-20 minutes for fueling and rental return, and roughly two hours at the terminal before departure. A 6:30 departure would still be workable if traffic is normal, but it leaves less recovery time.

Keep the Holiday Inn. The site hotel is not worth locking in Wednesday night, and I don’t want two airport-to-Goodyear commutes just to save about $52. Confirm the existing reservation and add the 6:15 departure to the itinerary.

Confirmed. Holiday Inn & Suites Goodyear remains reserved for April 6-9 at $571.26 including tax, with parking included. The itinerary now shows estimated site drives of 14-18 minutes and a 6:15 a.m. Thursday hotel departure for the rental return and 9:05 a.m. flight. The Phoenix trip projection remains $1,424, leaving $7 of the approved amount.
